label: Why truth discover left Fourth Way premises unresolved; grades frame and parameter sense tags
summary: Diagnosis of the two truth discover runs of 2026-11-20 (#1784; local reports .cache/discover/20261120T125406Z-YRT8KawP, 22 of 30 next-test targets unresolved, and 20261120T134013Z-vem5Npms, 12 of 24 modal targets unresolved). Classes: (a) load-bearing predicates are bare parameters with no unfoldable content and no sense tag, so each candidate entered the goal with its own copies (InAct_2, CausesIn_2, ...) and no candidate could reach the target; (b) the needed premise is absent; (c) retrieval or budget; (d) other. Report 1: (a) as the decisive blocker for CauseOfBeingCausesEveryPerfection (the residual and universal transfer premises entail it over one relation; verified result CausalPerfectionTransfer.reconstruction) and MaximumInGenusCausesAllInGenusReading (its candidate ClassicalAttributesLocalLogic.MaximumCausesAll is the same proposition by definition), and for ClassicalAttributesSuffice (attribute predicates as separate binders; its nine reported bridges are flagged domain_by_name). (b) with (a) as co-factor for the other Fourth Way, q.3, q.4 and attribute source readings (ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeing, PerfectionsOfEffectPreexistInCause, GodIsMaximalInBeing, GradesByApproachToAMaximum, GradesFoundInThings, MaximumInBeingIsFirstBeing, MostTrueIsMostBeing, CompositeHasAUnitingCause, CauseOfQualityInAnotherIsMoreSuch, ActSimplyPriorToPotency, NoComponentIsFirstBeing, GodNamesTheFullyDescribedPrinciple, ImmutableIsEternal, WillFollowsIntellect, ImmaterialIsIntellectual): source, observation or bridge premises that no corpus statement entails. (b) for the four stage-three targets (ResurrectionConfirmsMandate, CatholicChurchDefinitivelyProposesCreed, RevelationPossibleAndRecognizable, JesusClaimedDivineAuthorityAndRose): historical, doctrinal or bridge premises over the Signature fields. Report 2: no opaque primitive (residual binder separation remains across modules: frame…frame_6, w₀…w₀_4 are separate outer binders); every modal target is fully defined Kripke or Ontic vocabulary, and all 12 are (b), independent frame or profile conditions (T, B and 5 schemas, Euclidean, actual reflexivity, well-founded support, validity and theory-on-cone profiles, the S5 root node), with (d) for the schema-validity targets, whose formulas are evaluated by the recursive Holds, which delta-expansion does not unfold. Primitive binders behind (a), by statements whose declaration binds a parameter of that name (approximate, name-based count over 4083 declarations): InAct 202, esse 174, CausesIn 121, MoreIn 86, InPotency 69, PriorSimply 49, HasIntellect 38, IsGod 38, ComponentOf 36, Composite 36, HasWill 28, Eternal 16. Definitions: none of InAct, MoreIn, CausesIn, esse or PriorSimply has a faithful definition from more basic shared vocabulary; each is a primitive by design. InAct is deliberately sense-neutral (DISAMB-IN-ACT); MoreIn's proposed definitions (represented degree, approach to a primary, homogeneous scale) are contested readings, so the represented-degree comparative is recorded as the sibling MORE_2 (Grades.DegreeComparative, a strict order) beside the primitive MORE_1, with a check that they differ; CausesIn and PriorSimply already had senses (CAUSE_2, PRIOR_1). Added TruthCore.Causality.GradesFrame (checks Grades.primitive_not_degreeComparative and Grades.causeOfBeingCausesEveryPerfection_of_transfers, the latter reusing CausalPerfectionTransfer.reconstruction; GradesFrame extends CausalityFrame with InAct and MoreIn; adapters with Iff.rfl checks) and whole-binder sense tags on 37 quarta via (esse on 25 of them), q.4 and Stage-one declarations: IN_ACT_4 (new frame-field sense, mode left open), MORE_1 (new disambiguation MORE), CAUSE_2, the esse respect (new sense of the existence/esse disambiguation) and PRIOR_1. The esse tags were not put on QuartaViaStrictCausalTop, QuartaViaUnboundedDegrees and QuartaViaDegreeFork (added and then withdrawn on review): their paraphrases speak of a selected perfection or respect while their definition links and doc comments say being, and a tag would settle that existing ambiguity. ActPotencyRegress.ActualityWithoutBeingReading was left untagged: the declaration index does not find it (a docstring line in its module begins with 'end '). Carriers Being and Respect stay untagged (no sense for a respect carrier), so composed goals still use the flagged by-name carrier fallback. Measure (same pool all, default 8 candidates; before report at revision e61946aa, after report at revision 250e7c46, which also includes the merged #1820 and #1821; report .cache/discover/20261120T153149Z-jODj37wV): on the nine cluster targets, before 9 unresolved, after 3 proved and 6 unresolved, 0 discoveries. CauseOfBeingCausesEveryPerfection: the first proof found was the incompatibility QuartaViaStrictCausalTop with QuartaViaUnboundedDegrees (the two horns of QuartaViaDegreeFork contradict each other over the raw comparative, with no scale reading); with 3 candidates (report 20261120T154032Z-CjWFYRJA) it is proved from the residual and universal transfer premises and filtered known (argument 932ec4ec). ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeingReading: proved vacuously from the recorded rivals EmergentPerfectionReading and PerfectionsOfEffectPreexistInCauseReading, filtered known. MaximumInGenusCausesAllInGenusReading: proved from MaximumCausesAll, filtered transcription, senses and domain_by_name. Unresolved after tagging, (b), with residual binder separation across differently named carriers (B/R versus Being/Respect, as in GradesToMaximumAtBeing; see the carrier follow-up): PerfectionsOfEffectPreexistInCause, GodIsMaximalInBeing, GradesByApproachToAMaximum, GradesFoundInThings, MaximumInBeingIsFirstBeing, MostTrueIsMostBeing. The three missing bridges reported (CausesIn c x r gives InAct c r; PriorSimply x y gives IsGod x; InAct x r gives IsGod x) are domain_by_name-flagged candidate propositions, not premises; the last two are far stronger than any recorded reading. No corpus record, frontier premise or closure changes.
blocker: The six remaining cluster targets need premises the corpus does not state (class b); tags cannot supply them. A respect-carrier sense is needed before composed Fourth Way goals stop relying on the by-name carrier fallback. Follow-ups: register or reconcile the horn incompatibility of QuartaViaDegreeFork over the raw comparative; fix the declaration index for docstring lines beginning with 'end '; consider merging the frame-field definitions into DEF-ACT and DEF-ESSE once the affected arguments carry sense_bridges. MaximumCausesAll and MaximumInGenusCausesAllInGenusReading link different MAXIMAL senses (MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1 versus _6) although the first is defined as the second; reconcile their definition links. Once the Round3 calibration statements link the MORE_2 definition, list them as sense_bridges in the arguments that use them.
